_notes: Towers = disciples (ศิษย์) of a sect placed on the map. dmg per hit, rate = hits/s, range in tiles, cost in silver (ตำลึง). Values are prototype balance targets. All sect names are original (no Jin Yong / Gu Long IP). Tier 3 of a kit with two lvl-3 skills is a choice made on the upgrade: branch a (the original technique) or b; rule holds branch b's numbers (SPEC-pc-v2 §5). The yinyang kit has one tier 3.

rules.generateAdjacency: a disciple adjacent to a disciple of the element that generates it gains +15% dmg (สร้างเสริม / 相生)
rules.overcomeVsEnemy: damage vs enemy of the element it overcomes x1.2 (overcomePct); vs the element that overcomes it x0.85 (overcomeByPct) (ข่มกัน / 相克, SPEC-core §7)

roster._notes: Sect x role disciples for the sect the player picks (SPEC-core §4, roster.md §5). kit = the proven element mechanic the unit fights with (metal crit, fire splash, water slow, wood damage over time, yinyang support); sect = its element for Wu Xing and colour. dot: which status its damage over time applies (fire-sect units burn, wood-sect units poison). Sects without a roster yet play the legacy element disciples. Castle battle (SPEC-castle-battle, battle.json): move = march | capture | guard | fly | support, size = small | medium | large, mana = battle cost, hp = battle HP; dmg, rate, range and target are shared with defend. battleOnly units exist only in castle battle (no defend role or silver cost).
